_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} ku-Three-Player Tic Tac Toe. Isimboli yakho ngu-'{symbol}'. Uphenduka ubeka uphawu lwakho ebhodini le-5x5 ukuze wakhe umugqa wamane. Imigqa ingaba ngokwendawo, ngokuma, noma ngokuphambene. Thumela isinyathelo sakho usebenzisa ifomethi '[4]' ukumaka iseli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yokuthutha engalungile. Sebenzisa u-'[cell]' lapho iseli lingu-0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Inombolo yekheli engekho emthethweni: {cell}. Kumele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no {max_cell}.
